response.sql: SELECT AVG(CAST(spent AS REAL) / amount) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM budget WHERE spent >= 6.0;

assumptions.assumption: A missing ratio means a NULL ratio (NULL spent or amount, or amount = 0, which SQLite divides to NULL), so AVG skips it. Because the filter spent >= 6.0 already excludes NULL spent, only NULL or zero amounts are skipped.
The count covers all budget lines with spent >= 6.0, including those whose ratio is missing, because the request asks for the number of such lines.

alternatives.interpretation: Count only the lines that have a valid ratio, so the count matches the lines averaged.
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(CAST(spent AS REAL) / amount) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(CAST(spent AS REAL) / amount) AS line_count FROM budget WHERE spent >= 6.0;
